observation_law: independent Gaussian, price SD = c * frozen observed half_spread
training_selection: first 20000 physical rows of preserved 100000-row clean bank
posterior_family: BayesFlow 2.1 spline coupling flow, subnet widths [128,128]
optimizer: Adam, initial rate .0005, cosine horizon 10000, floor fraction .1
input_contract: ordered complete fixed 54-contract noisy prices divided by known half-spreads; no varying geometry or masking
noise_augmentation: fresh independent Gaussian errors on each training exposure; fixed c=1, no tau
randomness: runner records separate deterministic namespaces for row scheduling, training errors and fixed probes
validation_role: development only; repeated physical locations across checkpoints with fixed probe observations
first_nonfinite_policy: stop and preserve exact update/batch, metrics, gradients and available pre/post model/optimizer state; scheduled checkpoints remain immutable
conditional_panel: three predeclared synthetic cases (broad-prior, market-like, boundary) plus actual market mids, frozen before fitting

conditional_comparison.family_definition: 2 metrics * (5 physical parameters + 2 analytic variance products) * 4 cases * 2 checkpoints

scope: One bounded fixed-c development fit; no lesson release, inferred-c training, revised-grid labels or Bergomi production. No result selection from an improving loss curve.
